name: Grand Theft Auto: The Backstabber's Blues
summary: The untold story of your favorite trustworthy deuteragonist. Discover what Lance was up to while Tommy was busy taking over Vice City, learn the fate of 20 kilos of coke, three million of dollars and, of course, three mysterious assassins who just crossed the wrong man. Uncover the plot behind the notorious ambush and meet familiar characters from an all new perspective.
